name: Michael Jordan
clues: I was born in Brooklyn, New York, but grew up in North Carolina and played college ball there.
I won six NBA titles and six Finals MVP awards with one team.
I wore number 23 for the Chicago Bulls and starred in Space Jam.

name: LeBron James
clues: I was born in Akron, Ohio, and went straight from high school to the NBA.
I have won NBA titles with the Miami Heat, Cleveland Cavaliers and Los Angeles Lakers.
I became the NBA's all-time leading scorer in 2023.

name: Kobe Bryant
clues: I am the son of a former NBA player and spent part of my childhood in Italy.
I scored 81 points in a single game in 2006.
I played 20 seasons for the Lakers and wore numbers 8 and 24.

name: Stephen Curry
clues: I am the son of a former NBA player and went to Davidson College.
I was the first unanimous MVP in NBA history.
I changed the game with my three-point shooting for the Golden State Warriors.

name: Shaquille O'Neal
clues: I was the first overall pick in the 1992 draft, selected by the Orlando Magic.
I won three straight titles with the Lakers from 2000 to 2002, alongside Kobe.
I am 7'1" and my nickname is just three letters long: Shaq.
